title: AARO resolution of Aguadilla video
summary: Mick West tells of AARO resolution of Aguadilla video, about 2013 at Aguadilla, Puerto Rico, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: No, they did. They did. Aguadilla, which is uh which is one that existed before that.

plain: A well-known analyst of UFO videos, Mick West, points to the Aguadilla video, heat-camera footage from 2013 of an object near the airport at Aguadilla, Puerto Rico. He says AARO, the Pentagon's current office for investigating unexplained objects, did resolve that older case. He raises it to show the office has explained famous videos.
